# Course feedback digest
14 comments: 7 negative (50%), 3 mixed, 4 positive.
## Action items (most raised first)
1. assignments (3 students)
- Found lectures clear but says homework did not match the class content.
- Found the project 2 instructions confusing.
- Found the final project too big for the time given.
2. pacing (2 students)
- Found week 6 too fast to keep up with.
- Reports the week 6 week rushed to the course.
3. technology (2 students)
- Reports Gradescope crashing on submission 3.
- Says lab computers lacked Python 3.12 installed.
4. workload (1 student)
- Spends over 20 hours a week on the course.
5. assessment (1 student)
- Praises the slides but says the midterm covered material not taught in class.
6. support (1 student)
- Says emails to the professor went unanswered.
## What is working
- assessment (1): Found weekly quizzes a good check of understanding.
- materials (1): Found lectures made quickly and made revision easy.
- support (1): Appreciated the TAs' super patient TAs.
- technology (1): Found live coding demos useful for looping and functions.
